title.en_us: Storage Networks: AE2 or Refined Storage
title.es_es: Redes de almacenamiento: AE2 o Refined Storage

subtitle.en_us: One terminal for everything you own: how the two networks differ, where the pack gates them, and how to start.
subtitle.es_es: Una terminal para todo lo que tenés: en qué se diferencian las dos redes, dónde las escalona el pack y cómo empezar.

en_us.title: A Terminal That Knows Everything
en_us.subtitle: Search bar included.
text: [lead] A network turns items into data: insert once, then search, count, pull and autocraft from one terminal.
[li] [chapter:sector_ae2_network|Applied Energistics 2] and [chapter:sector_rs|Refined Storage], side by side
[li] Both are complete: pick one per base
The tech chapters go deeper into autocrafting, like [chapter:sector_ae2_automation|AE2 · Automation].

es_es.title: Una terminal que sabe todo
es_es.subtitle: Con buscador incluido.
text: [lead] Una red convierte los ítems en datos: los metés una vez y buscás, contás, sacás y autofabricás desde una terminal.
[li] [chapter:sector_ae2_network|Applied Energistics 2] y [chapter:sector_rs|Refined Storage], lado a lado
[li] Las dos están completas: elegí una por base
Los capítulos técnicos profundizan en el autocrafteo, como [chapter:sector_ae2_automation|AE2 · Automatización].

en_us.title: AE2 or RS?
en_us.subtitle: Depth or speed.
text: [lead] AE2 rewards planning; Refined Storage rewards impatience.
[li:ae2:certus_quartz_crystal] [hl|AE2]: deeper and more rewarding, with lots of add-ons in the pack
[li:refinedstorage:1k_storage_disk] [hl|Refined Storage]: no channels, just connect and power; faster to set up
{page}
AE2 cables carry limited [hl|channels]: [hl|8] on a normal cable, [hl|32] on a dense one. Layout matters.
Both store items, fluids and, with Mekanism add-ons, chemicals. Both craft on request.

es_es.title: ¿AE2 o RS?
es_es.subtitle: Profundidad o rapidez.
text: [lead] AE2 premia la planificación; Refined Storage, la impaciencia.
[li:ae2:certus_quartz_crystal] [hl|AE2]: más profundo y gratificante, con muchos complementos en el pack
[li:refinedstorage:1k_storage_disk] [hl|Refined Storage]: sin canales, conectar y dar energía; se arma más rápido
{page}
Los cables de AE2 llevan [hl|canales] limitados: [hl|8] en el cable normal, [hl|32] en el denso. El diseño importa.
Las dos guardan ítems, fluidos y, con complementos de Mekanism, químicos. Las dos fabrican a pedido.

en_us.title: Pack Change: When Each Opens
en_us.subtitle: Act III, both doors.
text: [lead] Both networks open in act III, each asking for its own part.
[li:entrelumen:routing_matrix] [hl|Refined Storage]: the [item:refinedstorage:controller|Controller] takes a [item:entrelumen:routing_matrix|Routing Matrix]
[li:entrelumen:handling_core] Its [item:refinedstorage:autocrafter|Autocrafter] takes a [item:entrelumen:handling_core|Handling Core]
[li:ae2:logic_processor] [hl|AE2]: the [item:ae2:inscriber|Inscriber]'s [item:ae2:logic_processor|Logic Processors]
{page}
The Routing Matrix is made from those same logic processors.
[note] The [item:ae2:controller|AE2 Controller] carries a Routing Matrix too, but a small AE2 network without a controller can start a little earlier.

es_es.title: Cambio del pack: cuándo abren
es_es.subtitle: Acto III, las dos puertas.
text: [lead] Las dos redes abren en el acto III y cada una pide su propia pieza.
[li:entrelumen:routing_matrix] [hl|Refined Storage]: el [item:refinedstorage:controller|Controlador] lleva una [item:entrelumen:routing_matrix|Matriz de distribución]
[li:entrelumen:handling_core] Su [item:refinedstorage:autocrafter|Autocrafter] lleva un [item:entrelumen:handling_core|Núcleo de manipulación]
[li:ae2:logic_processor] [hl|AE2]: los [item:ae2:logic_processor|Procesadores lógicos] del [item:ae2:inscriber|Inscriptor]
{page}
La Matriz de distribución se hace con esos mismos procesadores lógicos.
[note] El [item:ae2:controller|controlador de AE2] también lleva una Matriz de distribución, pero una red chica de AE2 sin controlador puede arrancar un poco antes.

en_us.title: AE2 Step 1: a Meteorite
en_us.subtitle: Sky stone included.
text: [lead] AE2 starts in a crater: a meteorite hides the presses that print your processors.
[li] A [item:ae2:mysterious_cube|Mysterious Cube] with the four inscriber presses: calculation, engineering, logic and silicon
[li] Sky stone
Presses plus an [item:ae2:inscriber|Inscriber] print processors.
{page}
[li:ae2:certus_quartz_crystal] Certus quartz grows from budding certus
[li] Charge it in a [item:ae2:charger|Charger], then drop it in water with redstone and nether quartz for fluix

es_es.title: AE2 paso 1: un meteorito
es_es.subtitle: Piedra celeste incluida.
text: [lead] AE2 empieza en un cráter: un meteorito esconde las prensas que imprimen tus procesadores.
[li] Un [item:ae2:mysterious_cube|Cubo misterioso] con las cuatro prensas del inscriptor: cálculo, ingeniería, lógica y silicio
[li] Piedra celeste
Prensas más un [item:ae2:inscriber|Inscriptor] imprimen procesadores.
{page}
[li:ae2:certus_quartz_crystal] El cuarzo de certus crece de certus en brote
[li] Cargalo en un [item:ae2:charger|Cargador] y tiralo al agua con redstone y cuarzo del Nether para obtener fluix

en_us.title: AE2 Step 2: a First Network
en_us.subtitle: The chests start feeling old.
text: [lead] Drive, cell, terminal and power: that is already a network.
[li:ae2:item_storage_cell_1k] An [item:ae2:drive|ME Drive] with a [item:ae2:item_storage_cell_1k|1k storage cell]
[li] A [item:ae2:terminal|terminal]
[li] Power from an [item:ae2:energy_acceptor|energy acceptor] or a [item:ae2:controller|controller]
{page}
Without a controller the network handles up to [hl|8] channel devices. With a controller and cables it grows far beyond.

es_es.title: AE2 paso 2: una primera red
es_es.subtitle: Los cofres empiezan a quedar viejos.
text: [lead] Drive, celda, terminal y energía: eso ya es una red.
[li:ae2:item_storage_cell_1k] Un [item:ae2:drive|ME Drive] con una [item:ae2:item_storage_cell_1k|celda de 1k]
[li] Una [item:ae2:terminal|terminal]
[li] Energía desde un [item:ae2:energy_acceptor|aceptador de energía] o un [item:ae2:controller|controlador]
{page}
Sin controlador la red maneja hasta [hl|8] dispositivos con canal. Con un controlador y cables crece mucho más.

en_us.title: Tip: AE2 Has Its Own Guide
text: [tip] AE2 ships an in-game guide with pictures and 3D scenes of every block.
[li:ae2:guide] Craft the [item:ae2:guide|Guide]
[li] Or bind [hl|Open Guide for Items] in Controls to jump from any AE2 item to its page
Read it once; it saves ten forum threads.

es_es.title: Truco: AE2 trae su guía
text: [tip] AE2 trae una guía en el juego con imágenes y escenas 3D de cada bloque.
[li:ae2:guide] Fabricá la [item:ae2:guide|Guía]
[li] O asigná [hl|Open Guide for Items] en Controles para saltar de cualquier ítem de AE2 a su página
Leela una vez; te ahorra diez foros.

en_us.title: AE2 Add-ons in the Pack
text: [lead] Bigger cells, better crafting and a terminal in your pocket.
[li:megacells:cell_component_1m] [hl|MEGA Cells]: much bigger cells
[li] [hl|ExtendedAE] and [hl|AdvancedAE]: better providers, interfaces and crafting
[li] [hl|AE2WTLib]: a wireless universal terminal
{page}
[li] [hl|Applied Mekanistics]: chemicals
[li] [hl|ME Requester]: keeps chosen items in stock
[li] [hl|AE2 Network Analyzer]: see channels and cables
[li] [hl|ArsEng]: Ars Nouveau source on the network
The details are in [chapter:sector_ae2_addons|AE2 · Addons].

es_es.title: Complementos de AE2
text: [lead] Celdas más grandes, mejor fabricación y una terminal en el bolsillo.
[li:megacells:cell_component_1m] [hl|MEGA Cells]: celdas mucho más grandes
[li] [hl|ExtendedAE] y [hl|AdvancedAE]: mejores proveedores, interfaces y fabricación
[li] [hl|AE2WTLib]: una terminal inalámbrica universal
{page}
[li] [hl|Applied Mekanistics]: químicos
[li] [hl|ME Requester]: mantiene en stock lo que elijas
[li] [hl|AE2 Network Analyzer]: ver canales y cables
[li] [hl|ArsEng]: la fuente de Ars Nouveau en la red
Los detalles están en [chapter:sector_ae2_addons|AE2 · Complementos].

en_us.title: RS: a First Network
en_us.subtitle: Just let them touch.
text: [lead] Controller, drive, grid: put them side by side and you have a network.
[li] A powered [item:refinedstorage:controller|Controller]
[li] A [item:refinedstorage:disk_drive|Disk Drive] with a storage disk
[li] A [item:refinedstorage:grid|Grid] or [item:refinedstorage:crafting_grid|Crafting Grid]
Join them with cables or let them touch. No channels: add as many devices as you like.
{page}
[note] The controller takes a Routing Matrix here, so RS starts in act III.

es_es.title: RS: una primera red
es_es.subtitle: Que se toquen y listo.
text: [lead] Controlador, drive, grid: ponelos uno al lado del otro y ya tenés una red.
[li] Un [item:refinedstorage:controller|Controlador] con energía
[li] Un [item:refinedstorage:disk_drive|Disk Drive] con un disco
[li] Una [item:refinedstorage:grid|Grid] o [item:refinedstorage:crafting_grid|Crafting Grid]
Unilos con cables o dejá que se toquen. Sin canales: sumá todos los dispositivos que quieras.
{page}
[note] Acá el controlador lleva una Matriz de distribución, así que RS arranca en el acto III.

en_us.title: RS: Growing the Network
text: [lead] Everything else in RS plugs onto the same network.
[li] [item:refinedstorage:importer|Importer] and [item:refinedstorage:exporter|Exporter]: move items in and out of machines
[li] [item:refinedstorage:constructor|Constructor] and [item:refinedstorage:destructor|Destructor]: place and break blocks
[li] [item:refinedstorage:detector|Detector]: emits redstone by amount
{page}
[li] [item:refinedstorage:wireless_transmitter|Wireless Transmitter]: serves a wireless grid
[li] [item:refinedstorage:network_transmitter|Network Transmitter] and [item:refinedstorage:network_receiver|Receiver]: link distant parts
[li] [item:refinedstorage:autocrafter|Autocrafter]: runs [item:refinedstorage:pattern_grid|Pattern Grid] patterns
RS Mekanism Integration adds chemicals.

es_es.title: RS: hacer crecer la red
text: [lead] Todo lo demás de RS se enchufa a la misma red.
[li] [item:refinedstorage:importer|Importer] y [item:refinedstorage:exporter|Exporter]: meten y sacan ítems de las máquinas
[li] [item:refinedstorage:constructor|Constructor] y [item:refinedstorage:destructor|Destructor]: ponen y rompen bloques
[li] [item:refinedstorage:detector|Detector]: emite redstone según la cantidad
{page}
[li] [item:refinedstorage:wireless_transmitter|Wireless Transmitter]: sirve una grid inalámbrica
[li] [item:refinedstorage:network_transmitter|Network Transmitter] y [item:refinedstorage:network_receiver|Receiver]: unen partes lejanas
[li] [item:refinedstorage:autocrafter|Autocrafter]: ejecuta patrones de la [item:refinedstorage:pattern_grid|Pattern Grid]
RS Mekanism Integration suma químicos.

en_us.title: Keep Your Drawers
en_us.subtitle: Your drawers stay put.
text: [lead] Your chests and drawers join the network without being emptied.
[li] AE2's [item:ae2:storage_bus|Storage Bus] and RS's [item:refinedstorage:external_storage|External Storage] read any inventory they face
[li] Drawers and storage controllers included
[li] The terminal shows those items too
The drawer wall joins the network without moving a single cobblestone.

es_es.title: Conservá tus cajones
es_es.subtitle: Tus cajones no se mueven.
text: [lead] Tus cofres y cajones se suman a la red sin vaciarlos.
[li] El [item:ae2:storage_bus|Storage Bus] de AE2 y el [item:refinedstorage:external_storage|External Storage] de RS leen cualquier inventario al que apuntan
[li] Cajones y controladores incluidos
[li] La terminal también muestra esos ítems
La pared de cajones se suma a la red sin mover ni una piedra.

en_us.title: Autocrafting in One Paragraph
en_us.subtitle: Ask for 64, get 64.
text: [lead] Encode a recipe once, then ask the terminal for 64 of anything.
[li] Encode it into a [hl|pattern]

[li] Give the network somewhere to run it: an [item:ae2:pattern_provider|AE2 pattern provider] with a [item:ae2:molecular_assembler|molecular assembler] or a machine, or an [item:refinedstorage:autocrafter|RS autocrafter]
[li] In AE2, add a [hl|crafting CPU]
{page}
It crafts the intermediate steps too.
[note] Act components are ordinary shaped recipes, so they autocraft like anything else.

es_es.title: Autocrafteo en un párrafo
es_es.subtitle: Pedí 64, tené 64.
text: [lead] Guardá una receta una vez y pedile 64 de lo que sea a la terminal.
[li] Guardala en un [hl|patrón]

[li] Dale a la red dónde ejecutarla: un [item:ae2:pattern_provider|proveedor de patrones de AE2] con un [item:ae2:molecular_assembler|ensamblador molecular] o una máquina, o un [item:refinedstorage:autocrafter|autocrafter de RS]
[li] En AE2, sumá una [hl|CPU de fabricación]
{page}
También hace los pasos intermedios.
[note] Los componentes de acto son recetas con forma comunes, así que se autocraftean como cualquier cosa.

en_us.title: Quirk: Both Can Coexist
en_us.subtitle: A barrel makes a fine embassy.
text: [lead] AE2 in one base and Refined Storage in another is fine.
They do not share storage directly: bridge them through an inventory both can read, like a drawer or chest.
[tip] For one team, one network is almost always easier.

es_es.title: Particularidad: pueden convivir
es_es.subtitle: Un barril es buena embajada.
text: [lead] AE2 en una base y Refined Storage en otra está bien.
No comparten almacenamiento directamente: unilas con un inventario que las dos puedan leer, como un cajón o un cofre.
[tip] Para un equipo, una sola red casi siempre es más fácil.

en_us.title: Tip: Channels Without Tears
text: [tip] Run dense cable as the backbone and branch with normal cable.
[li] Each AE2 device uses [hl|1] channel
[li] Normal cables carry [hl|8], dense ones [hl|32]
[li] Each controller face feeds [hl|32]
A powered device that stops working probably ran out of channels. The [hl|Network Analyzer] shows where.

es_es.title: Truco: canales sin lágrimas
text: [tip] Usá cable denso como columna vertebral y ramificá con el normal.
[li] Cada dispositivo de AE2 usa [hl|1] canal
[li] El cable normal lleva [hl|8], el denso [hl|32]
[li] Cada cara del controlador alimenta [hl|32]
Un dispositivo con energía que deja de andar probablemente se quedó sin canales. El [hl|Network Analyzer] muestra dónde.

en_us.title: The Network Feeds the Story
text: [lead] Several act components are made from network parts.
[li:entrelumen:routing_matrix] [item:entrelumen:routing_matrix|Routing Matrix]: logic processors and a circuit board
[li:entrelumen:habitation_contract] [item:entrelumen:habitation_contract|Habitation Charter]: a calculation processor
[li:entrelumen:inventory_sensor] [item:entrelumen:inventory_sensor|Inventory Sensor]: LaserIO logic chips
A network that autocrafts processors makes acts III and V much lighter.

es_es.title: La red alimenta la historia
text: [lead] Varios componentes de acto se hacen con piezas de redes.
[li:entrelumen:routing_matrix] [item:entrelumen:routing_matrix|Matriz de distribución]: procesadores lógicos y una placa de circuito
[li:entrelumen:habitation_contract] [item:entrelumen:habitation_contract|Carta de habitabilidad]: un procesador de cálculo
[li:entrelumen:inventory_sensor] [item:entrelumen:inventory_sensor|Sensor de inventario]: chips lógicos de LaserIO
Una red que autofabrica procesadores aliviana mucho los actos III y V.

en_us.title: Everything in One Place
en_us.subtitle: Search, don't hunt.
text: [lead] The whole base is now one searchable inventory.
Logistics stops being about finding items and starts being about feeding machines.
You will never again lose a stack of iron in chest number forty.

es_es.title: Todo en un solo lugar
es_es.subtitle: Buscá, no rastrees.
text: [lead] Toda la base es ahora un inventario donde se puede buscar.
La logística pasa a ser alimentar máquinas en vez de encontrar ítems.
Nunca más vas a perder una pila de hierro en el cofre número cuarenta.

en_us.title: Flip the Switch
text: [lead] One lever, two networks, every light on.
Both racks glow at once: the drives, the terminal, the controller and the grid.

es_es.title: Tirar la palanca
text: [lead] Una palanca, dos redes, todas las luces prendidas.
Los dos racks brillan a la vez: los drives, la terminal, el controlador y la grid.

en_us.title: Type "iron"
text: [lead] Four letters and every iron ingot lights up.
Now imagine it with forty chests behind it.

es_es.title: Escribir «hierro»
text: [lead] Seis letras y cada lingote de hierro se ilumina.
Ahora imaginalo con cuarenta cofres detrás.
